Sets the SerializableFunction that gets
each client a store. The parameter is the client
name that an individual client of the sink will
use.

Sets the publish command for the sink.
Valid commands include:
"publish" (Default)
"sow_delete"
"delta_publish" (May require a custom
serialization schema)

Sets the supplier that gets each client a
FailedWriteHandler. The supplier must be
serializable.

Sets the supplier that gets each client a
ReconnectDelayStrategy. Default uses
exponential delay. The supplier must be
serializable.

Sets the supplier that gets each client an
exception listener. The supplier must be
serializable.

Sets the heartbeat interval in seconds for the
clients.

Set whether or not messages being sent to the
server should retry if the client is
disconnected.
